name: City of Boroondara Camberwell data centre
notes: Older government IT article says City of Melbourne servers occupied around half of Boroondara's Camberwell data centre under a disaster-recovery colocation arrangement; no current operating or capacity data found.

name: CDC Brooklyn Campus
notes: CDC says BK1 in Brooklyn is fully operational, the remaining Brooklyn campus facilities are under construction, and Brooklyn is expected to provide over 350 MW on completion.

name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne
notes: NEXTDC lists M2 at 75 Sharps Road, Tullamarine, with 120MW+ IT capacity; Brimbank council records include a 2025 amended permit for a data centre at 75 Sharps Rd.

name: 43-45 Tullamarine Park Road data centre
notes: Brimbank Council April 2025 planning activity attachment records an amended permit issued on 18 March 2025 to alter the height and layout of the data centre at 43-45 Tullamarine Park Rd.

name: 90-92 Boundary Road Sunshine West data centre
notes: Brimbank public planning register lists application P588/2025 for development and use of land for a data centre within DDO11 at 90-92 Boundary Rd, Sunshine West; permit issued by delegate on 13 April 2026.

name: 11A McDonald Road Brooklyn data centre
notes: Brimbank public planning register lists application P588/2025 for development and use of land for a data centre within DDO11 and car parking at 11A McDonald Rd, Brooklyn; permit issued by delegate on 28 May 2026.

name: 585 Berwick-Cranbourne Road Clyde North data centre
notes: City of Casey says it received its first data-centre planning permit application for 585 Berwick-Cranbourne Road, Clyde North and is reviewing/requesting additional information; DCD reports the application indicates up to AU$1.1b investment on about 53.6 ha.
